name: Li Chia-yu
bio: Li Chia-yu is dated by Giles to the 8th or 9th century AD. His poem here is a summer poem of retirement.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: In Retirement
poems.author: Li Chia-yu
poems.text:
He envies none, the pure and proud ex-Minister of State;
On the Western Lake he shuts himself within his bamboo gate.
He needs no fan to cool his brow, for the south wind never lulls.
While idly his official hat lies staring at the gulls.

poems.title: 竹樓 (Zhu lou)
poems.author: Li Chia-yu
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
傲吏身閒笑五侯，西江取竹起高樓。
南風不用蒲葵扇，紗帽閒眠對水鷗。
